mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the wound with the stolen meal was most worthwhile: it distinguished suffering harm from choosing wrongdoing without implying that suffering means guilt.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final connection to Genesis felt less engaging because it largely extended the wound example already established, although its qualification about the starting premise was useful.

surprise.text: The explicit point that the healing wound does not establish creation's goodness sharpened my understanding of the argument's limits.
